text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Yasuda Kinen. Matikanetannhauser pumps herself up for her race against Ikuno Dictus while she enjoys a pudding she brought with her from the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ikuno Dictus comes to greet her before the race and points out that the pudding is long expired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even though she's our rival, Ikuno Dictus is relieved that Matikanetannhauser is able to avoid getting sick before the race. We thank her for the kind thoughts, and the Yasuda Kinen begins!
